rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and therefore did not fabricate embryo morphology. It omitted image-based assessment, but this is appropriate rather than inaccurate.

It integrated age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm quality, BMI, endometrium, and prior cycle history into prognosis well, though interaction with actual embryo morphology was limited because morphology was unavailable.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors. Minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative adjustments despite absent embryo morphology.

Much of the advice is broadly evidence-based, but recommending ERA after only one additional failure and suggesting immunologic/NK testing are not strongly guideline-supported for routine use; PGT-A at age 25 is also debatable.
The response gives practical next steps for transfer support and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard and could be better prioritized.
